The '''Karfeddion system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]].<ref name="TEA" />
